description: This file defines the BrowserDispatcher class, which manages browser instances and their contexts, handling events, creating new contexts, and interfacing with browser features like tracing and CDP sessions within the Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: BrowserDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher class for managing browser instances, handling events, creating contexts, and interfacing with browser features in Playwright.

methods.name: _didClose
methods.description: Handles cleanup and event dispatch when the browser is closed.

methods.name: newContext
methods.description: Creates a new browser context, optionally recording video, and manages context dispatching.

methods.name: newContextForReuse
methods.description: Creates a new browser context for reuse and dispatches the event.

methods.name: disconnectFromReusedContext
methods.description: Disconnects from a reused context, stopping pending operations and disposing of the dispatcher.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the browser unless ignored by options.

methods.name: killForTests
methods.description: Kills the browser process for testing purposes unless ignored by options.

methods.name: defaultUserAgentForTest
methods.description: Returns the default user agent string for the browser.

methods.name: newBrowserCDPSession
methods.description: Creates a new Chrome DevTools Protocol session if the browser is Chromium.

methods.name: stopTracing
methods.description: Stops tracing and retrieves the trace artifact in Chromium browsers.

methods.name: startServer
methods.description: Starts a server with specified parameters.

methods.name: cleanupContexts
methods.description: Closes all isolated contexts during cleanup.
